analogy.rationale: DNMT inhibitors are nucleoside analogs that incorporate into DNA and covalently trap DNMTs, causing DNA damage and epigenetic derepression; HDAC inhibitors share the epigenetic/chromatin-modifying downstream program, while other DNA-targeting and antineoplastic classes overlap in DNA damage and growth-arrest responses.
